basics.name: resourceGroupName
basics.label: Agent resource group
basics.toolTip: Resource group for the agent and its telemetry.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an Azure resource group name.

basics.name: agentName
basics.label: Agent base name
basics.toolTip: The deployment appends the cost data source to the agent name.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter 3 to 56 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens, beginning and ending with a letter or digit.

elements.name: mode
elements.label: Cost data source
elements.toolTip: Choose how the agent collects financial evidence.

elements.name: clusterUri
elements.label: FinOps hub database URI
elements.toolTip: Use the URI for the Hub database on the existing Azure Data Explorer cluster.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the Azure Data Explorer URI ending in /Hub.

elements.name: clusterResourceId
elements.label: Azure Data Explorer cluster resource ID
elements.toolTip: The deployment grants read access to the Hub and Ingestion databases on this cluster.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an Azure Data Explorer cluster resource ID.

elements.name: subscriptionReader
elements.label: Grant Reader on this subscription
elements.toolTip: Select if the monitored workflows need subscription-wide inventory or quota evidence.

elements.name: subscriptionCostReader
elements.label: Grant Cost Management Reader on this subscription
elements.toolTip: Select to enable subscription-scope cost queries in this subscription.
